veranderings.rede: A camera is naturally called a 'toestel' in Afrikaans; 'masjien' sounds wooden for a hand-held device.

veranderings.blok: Die volgorde waarin gewone mense hulle kon begin gebruik
veranderings.voor: waarin gewone mense hulle kon begin gebruik
veranderings.na: waarin gewone mense hierdie uitvindings kon begin gebruik
veranderings.rede: The pronoun 'hulle' in the heading has no antecedent; naming the items makes the heading stand on its own.
'Vat ... weg' is colloquial; 'neem ... weg' is the standard written form for study text.
